items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know you’d covered one of Sonny Boy Williamson’s tunes

ctx.x: I know you’d covered one of Sonny Boy Williamson’s tunes, so I wondered if you’d listened to King Biscuit Time.
No, I didn’t listen to the King Biscuit Time show. I never heard that until later. I heard about it.
